The last friday, The Basque Association of Beach Tennis and Minority Sports organized the VIII. Basque Tournament of Footbag Net (Individual). We gathered in the fronton of Altamira (Bilbao) because it was a rainy day.
It was a great tournament, short but we passed a great time. These were the results:
Preliminary round
Daniel Barrientos 5-4 Arrate Elorrieta
Semifinals
Egoitz Campo 9-5 Joseba Zubiaurre
Daniel Barrientos 6-1 Ariana Mungia
Final
Egoitz Campo 10-4 Daniel Barrientos
